title: Present perfect continuous (I have been doing)

lesson.summary:
Present perfect continuous dibentuk dengan *have/has been + V-ing*. Ada dua pemakaian utama.

Pertama, untuk aktivitas yang baru saja berhenti atau masih berlangsung, dan hasilnya terlihat sekarang: *The ground is wet. It's been raining.* (hujannya mungkin sudah berhenti). *You're out of breath. Have you been running?*

Kedua, untuk menyatakan berapa lama sebuah aktivitas sudah berlangsung sampai sekarang, sering dengan *how long, for, since*: *We've been waiting for half an hour. Ani has been learning English since she was ten.*

Bandingkan dengan present continuous. *I'm waiting* hanya berarti saya sedang menunggu sekarang. Kalau ada keterangan berapa lama sampai sekarang, bentuknya harus present perfect continuous: *I've been waiting for an hour* (bukan *I'm waiting for an hour*).

patterns.formula: How long + have/has + subjek + been + V-ing … ?
patterns.example: How long have you been waiting?

patterns.formula: … been + V-ing + for + durasi / since + titik awal

examples.en: The ground is wet. It's been raining.
You're out of breath. Have you been running?
We've been waiting for the bus for half an hour.
examples.id: Kami sudah menunggu bus selama setengah jam.

examples.en: Ani has been learning English since she was ten.
examples.id: Ani sudah belajar bahasa Inggris sejak umur sepuluh tahun.

examples.en: My eyes hurt because I've been looking at a screen all day.
examples.id: Mata saya sakit karena seharian menatap layar.

examples.en: My neighbours have been playing loud music since this morning.
examples.id: Tetangga saya memutar musik keras sejak tadi pagi.

commonMistakes.wrong: I'm waiting here since ten o'clock.
commonMistakes.right: I've been waiting here since ten o'clock.
commonMistakes.why: Durasi sampai sekarang (*since*, *for*) tidak memakai present continuous. Pakai *have been + V-ing*.

commonMistakes.wrong: She has been study all night.
commonMistakes.right: She has been studying all night.

commonMistakes.wrong: How long are you learning to drive?
commonMistakes.right: How long have you been learning to drive?
commonMistakes.why: *How long* sampai sekarang memakai present perfect continuous.

questions.explanation: Hasilnya terlihat sekarang (terengah-engah): Have you been running?
Aktivitas yang baru berhenti dengan hasil terlihat: has been raining.

questions.sentence: We {{1}} for the bus for half an hour.
questions.explanation: Durasi sampai sekarang (for half an hour): have been waiting.

questions.sentence: Ani {{1}} English since she was ten.
questions.explanation: since + titik awal: has been learning.
Untuk work, present perfect simple dan continuous sama-sama benar.

questions.sentence: My eyes hurt because I {{1}} at a screen all day.
questions.explanation: Aktivitas panjang yang hasilnya terasa sekarang (mata sakit).

questions.sentence: Why are your hands so dirty? – I {{1}} the motorbike.
questions.explanation: Aktivitas yang baru selesai, dan buktinya tangan kotor: have been fixing.

questions.sentence: My neighbours {{1}} loud music since this morning.
questions.explanation: since this morning: have been playing.

options.why: Benar. Menanyakan durasi aktivitas sampai sekarang.
Pertanyaan dengan long (berapa lama sampai sekarang) tidak memakai present continuous.

questions.explanation: Durasi sampai sekarang: have been + V-ing.

questions.sentence: She's tired because she ___ all morning.

options.why: Benar. Aktivitas panjang yang hasilnya terasa sekarang (lelah).
Kalimat ini menjelaskan penyebab lelahnya dengan all morning, jadi perlu present perfect continuous.

questions.explanation: all morning sampai sekarang + hasil terlihat: has been + V-ing.

questions.sentence: He ___ for an hour, and he's still talking!

options.why: Benar. Durasi sampai sekarang dan masih berlangsung.
for an hour (sampai sekarang) tidak dipakai dengan present continuous.
Kalimatnya menyatakan aktivitas yang masih berlangsung.

questions.explanation: for + durasi sampai sekarang: have/has been + V-ing.

options.why: since tidak dipakai dengan present continuous.
Benar. since + titik awal sampai sekarang.
lived berarti sudah tidak tinggal di sana lagi.

questions.explanation: since + titik awal: present perfect (continuous).

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.corrected: I have been waiting here since ten o'clock.
questions.explanation: since + titik awal: have been waiting.

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.corrected: She looks exhausted. She has been studying all night.
questions.explanation: Setelah been perlu bentuk -ing: has been studying.

segments: to drive? – For six months now.
questions.corrected: How long have you been learning to drive? – For six months now.
questions.explanation: How long sampai sekarang: have you been learning.

questions.corrected: They have been playing games since lunch.
questions.explanation: Setelah been perlu bentuk -ing: playing.
